historical_record.description: The Office of the Assessor-Recorder photographed the property for tax assessment. Leary Bros. Morticians and San Francisco Florist were at the address.
An existing two-story building stood at the property.
The City Planning Commission approved the conditional use authorization to add five dwelling units to a commercial building without providing off-street parking.
